question: Who among the following was NOT a gold medallist at the Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pooja Gehlot**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pooja Gehlot is an Indian wrestler who competed in the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• She did not win a gold medal at the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• Pooja Gehlot, however, secured a bronze medal in the Women's Freestyle 50kg category.
 
• Other Indian wrestlers such as Naveen Kumar, Ravi Dahiya, and Vinesh Phogat won gold medals in their respective categories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games**

 
 
• The Commonwealth Games, often referred to as the Friendly Games, is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930 and has taken place every four years since then.
 
• It is overseen by the Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF), which is responsible for the direction and control of the Commonwealth Games.
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games were held in Birmingham, England from 28 July to 8 August 2022.
 
 
 
• **Wrestling at the Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• Wrestling has been a part of the Commonwealth Games program since the 1930 British Empire Games.
 
• It includes both freestyle and Greco-Roman categories for men, and freestyle categories for women.
 
• Indian wrestlers have traditionally performed well at the Commonwealth Games, winning numerous medals.
 
 
 
• **Indian Wrestlers at the Commonwealth Games 2022**
 
 
• **Naveen Kumar** won gold in the Men's Freestyle 74kg category.
 
• **Ravi Dahiya** clinched gold in the Men's Freestyle 57kg category.
 
• **Vinesh Phogat** secured gold in the Women's Freestyle 53kg category.
 
• **Pooja Gehlot** won a bronze medal in the Women's Freestyle 50kg category.
